ground_truth: model_parameters.json + tracer.json (lens Sersics, SIE, shear) + source_plane_reconstruction.fits (source map)

simulator.noise_model: sigma^2 = (I + b) / t, Poisson on (I + b) * t counts
simulator.forward_model: 4x4 sub-sampled ray-tracing; source map interpolated at traced positions
simulator.note: t and b are effective values fitted to the real noise map; the real map's 1/f correction is not reproduced.

caveats: positions.json and info.json are copied from the real lens.
mask_extra_galaxies.fits is all-clear (no contaminants are simulated).
noise_map_psffloor.fits uses the real psf_err.fits; the mock PSF is exact, so the floor is for layout parity only.
